blocks.h2: Reasons to Get a Sewer Camera Inspection in Hinsdale
blocks.intro: Most inspections start with one of these:

tiles.body: A house from the early 1900s almost certainly has an old lateral.
Find out whether the existing line to the street is worth keeping.
Learn whether it's roots, a sag or a break.
Find out if it was your line or an overloaded sewer.

blocks.h2: What We Find in Hinsdale Sewer Lines
blocks.intro: Footage in Hinsdale varies a lot from one street to the next.

items.body: The most common finding under older homes.
A new foundation connected to an old clay or cast iron line.
Different materials joined together over decades of fixes.
Sometimes the pipe is fine and only needs jetting.

blocks.h2: Scoping the Sewer in a Historic Hinsdale Home
blocks.body: Homes in and around the Robbins Park Historic District include some of the oldest in the area, and their sewer laterals can be just as old. Even newer homes on older lots may tie into an original line at the property edge. A camera inspection before you buy or renovate shows the material, the condition and any roots or breaks, so you can plan a repair before it becomes an emergency.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Sewer Inspection
blocks.body: Access and line length matter most. A long run on a large lot takes more time. If the line is blocked, we clear it first. We quote a flat price before we start.

blocks.h2: Sewer Camera Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Should I get a sewer inspection before buying in Hinsdale?
items.preview: Yes, especially for an older home.
items.answer: Yes. A standard home inspection doesn't include the sewer line. For an older home, the camera can turn up a repair worth negotiating.

items.q: We're tearing down and rebuilding. Should we inspect the old line?
items.preview: Yes, before you decide to reuse it.
items.answer: Yes. Before the builder ties the new house into the existing lateral, a camera inspection tells you whether that line is worth keeping.

items.q: Can you tell how deep the problem is?
items.answer: Yes. The camera head carries a transmitter, and our locator marks both the spot and the depth from the surface.

items.q: Do I get to keep the video?
items.answer: Yes. You keep the recording for your records, a sale or a repair quote.

items.q: Can a camera inspection help with a renovation plan?
items.answer: Yes. It tells you whether the sewer should be repaired before new floors and finishes go in.

items.q: How much does a sewer camera inspection cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on access and length. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access and the length of the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
